tips.text: Run Persto Survival to 20 minutes; one run covers all three parts.
Skip Munio Mirror Defense; players widely call it the most miserable of the three.
Rush each bounty and leave; staying longer does not improve the blueprint roll.
Skip the 65-70 tier; its blueprint chance is the lowest of the five.
Run a lower tier if a higher one is locked; every tier except 65-70 pays about the same.
Do not grind Cavia standing for Mandonel parts; Bird 3 sells nothing for it.
Do a Survival bounty to 20 minutes so one run rolls the blueprint and the Persto part tables together.
Expect a wide spread: some players ran 100 bounties with nothing, others finished in about 20.
Players call the weapon clunky and rarely used; most build it for Mastery and Qorvex.
